title: Decide whether tadu migrate refuses a TODO.md with loose text or keeps it as untriaged tasks
blocker: Waiting for the owner's answer: refuse and list, or keep loose TODO.md text as untriaged tasks.
notes: Today (session 17 choice) migrate refuses and lists every TODO.md line that sits in no item (unplaced_refusal in migration_refusal); only TODO_LOG.md prose becomes closed tasks. The 2026-11-18 report on ~/p had 206 such lines, so the owner would move them by hand.

Option A, keep the refusal: nothing is ever guessed, but a large backlog needs manual edits first. Option B, drop the refusal: loose_text_task already turns each block into a pending untriaged task holding the text whole, so migrate runs in one go; the cost is untriaged tasks to sort afterwards.
Recommended: B, with the loose blocks listed in the dry run as the log's are. Not changed without the owner's answer: it reverses a deliberate choice.
result: Owner chose B: migrate turns TODO.md loose blocks into pending untriaged tasks and lists them in the plan
evidence: tests/test_migrate_loses_nothing.py and tests/test_finish_leftovers.py cover it; gate green
